title: Air Fryer Puffed Butter Beans
description: Crispy on the outside, creamy on the inside, these puffed butter beans cooked in the air fryer will be your new favorite healthy snack.
ingredients: 1 (16 ounce) can large butter beans, drained and rinsed

steps.text: Stir together butter beans, olive oil, salt, pepper, and garlic powder in a bowl until combined. Spread out in the air fryer basket
Preheat an air fryer to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C).
Air fry until golden and crispy, tossing halfway through, for 12 to 15 minutes.
Sprinkle with additional seasonings to taste if you like. Store in an air-tight container for 3 to 5 days.

video.description: Crispy on the outside, creamy on the inside, puffed butter beans will be your new favorite healthy snack. This video shows you how to make puffed beans in the air fryer with a can of large butter beans and a few pantry staples you probably have on hand. Cooked in the air fryer to create a golden, savory shell, these beans can add delicious texture to soups, salads, and snack mixes. Toss with your favorite fresh or dried seasonings to add even more flavor.
